title: Uniform Asymptotics of the Pseudo Wigner-Ville Distribution for Nonlinear Chirps
summary: The analysis of non stationary signals in complex physical systems often relies on Time Frequency distributions. Among these, the Pseudo Wigner Ville Distribution (PWVD) stands out for its superior resolution but is mathematically challenging due to its inherent quadratic nonlinearity. This nonlinearity generates complex interference artifacts and cross terms in the phase space, potentially obscuring the physical features of the signal, particularly for nonlinear chirps.
